name: image_adjudication_cx_vs_obd_agent
functionality: Fraud Detection Specialist - cross-references OBD Images (Proof of Delivery) against Customer Images (Proof of Claim) to detect switcheroo fraud or validate damage claims. 4-Step algorithm: Step 1 (Visibility Firewall), Step 2 (Identity & Fraud Screen with ROI-based comparison), Step 3 (Region of Interest verification for defect claims), Step 4 (Structural Integrity - safe disassembly vs critical damage).
inputs: cx_images (customer images), obd_images (delivery images), return_reason, return_sub_reason, vertical
promptDescription: Dedicated prompt (not FK_PROMPT series). Role: Fraud Detection Specialist for e-commerce logistics. Core Behavioral Constraint: STRICT VISUAL EVIDENCE ONLY - passive observer, never assume brand demographics or hidden features. 4-Step Reasoning: Step 1: Visibility Firewall (Absolute Closed Box rule, Partial Reveal exception, Blurry/Corrupt check). Step 2: Identity & Fraud Screen (Source of Truth rule, Common Denominator rule for partial views, Identity Matrix, ROI Conflict rule). Step 3: ROI Verification (Anatomical Region rule). Step 4: Structural Integrity (Safe Disassembly vs Critical Damage).
promptVersions: v2.0 (Author: raghavendra.b, Updated: 2026-01-16) - dedicated CX vs OBD prompt
